caption: The bending moment sets the boom force; its gradient sets dP/dz and the bending flow. The boom slope turns part of the boom force into a transverse component that appears as a taper shear flow. In the worked example the taper term cancels 40 of the 100 N/mm bending flow.

spec.title: Taper shear flow in a two-boom spar

aria: Block diagram: root bending moment gives shear force and a 200 kN boom force, the boom slope of -0.04 gives a taper shear flow of -40 N/mm, which is added to the 100 N/mm bending flow to give 60 N/mm in the web.
